title: Cloud and provisioning timeouts from measured latency
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. cloud_scout_timeout_secs and model_provisioning_wait_secs derived from measured round trips and bandwidth. Tests zc_timeouts_measured_*.
